debug_level.description: Debug log level: 0 (none) to 9 (all). Higher = more verbose.

log_stderror.description: Log to standard error instead of syslog. Set to 'yes' for containerized deployments.

mem_dump_shared.description: Dump shared memory stats on exit. Useful for debugging memory leaks.

max_fwd.description: Maximum allowed value in the Max-Forwards header. Prevents infinite loops.

stats_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between statistics dumps to the statistics module.

auth_enabled.description: Enable SIP authentication (Digest). Requires auth module and database.

listeners.description: Network interfaces and ports to listen on. Each entry includes protocol, address, and port.

protocol.description: Transport protocol: tcp, udp, or tls.

tags.description: Optional listener tags for routing control (e.g., ["internal", "external"]).

aliases.description: Additional SIP hostnames/IPs this server accepts calls for (e.g., domain aliases).

db_url.description: Database connection URL. Format: driver://user:pass@host/dbname. Supported: mysql, postgres, sqlite.

modules.description: Module-specific parameters. Each object defines module name, parameter name, and value.

name.description: Kamailio module name (e.g., auth, tls, redis).

value.description: Parameter value (will be rendered as JSON for booleans/numbers/strings).

upstreams.description: Upstream SIP gateways for routing calls. Each defines a prefix match, name, and optional backup gateways.

name.description: Identifier for the upstream (used in route names and logs).

prefix.description: SIP username or URI prefix to match for routing to this gateway (e.g., '123' for +123* numbers).

backups.description: List of backup upstream gateway names (fallback order if primary fails).

items.description: Name of a backup upstream gateway.
